body:
The PR replaces the usage of the `mutateMe` function. This function has been removed from the latest version of the Helper. We leverage the internals of the Helper to remove the parameters added by the widget. You can verify that the tests pass for the connector with:

```
yarn jest src/connectors/configure/__tests__/connectConfigure-test.js
```

> The CI does not pass, it's expected. It won't pass until the last PR of the stack.
